events.text: Iris, a reminder of our standing arrangement: once a parents' evening or any other parent-facing event is confirmed with families, its date or venue may only be changed with my written agreement. Please route any proposed move through me before touching the booking.
Finance policy for this year: any supplier order above 150 pounds needs Malik's sign-off before it is placed. Orders at or below 150 can go straight ahead from the school office.
Roll count after half term: 214 pupils on roll, including 26 new starters in Reception in September.
Attached is our price list for the autumn term: cardigans 12 pounds, polo shirts 7 pounds, book bags 6 pounds. Same terms as last year.
Summer fair debrief: raised 840 pounds, class 3 cake stall the top earner. Thanks recorded to all volunteers. No actions for the office beyond banking the takings.
Confirmed the absence line routine with the office team: parents ring before 09:15, we log the reason, and follow up any unexplained absence by 10:30.
Booking confirmed for the Year 6 swimming run on Tuesdays through the autumn term, 30-seat coach, 95 pounds per trip, picking up at the school gate at 13:15.

Confirming your booking enquiry: our main hall is available on Thursday 15 October, 17:00 to 20:00, for your autumn parents' evening. Hire fee 120 pounds for the evening. The centre is on Wren Lane with parking for about 40 cars, which usually covers a school evening well.
Happy to provide refreshments for your parents' evening: tea, coffee and biscuits for 90 parents, delivered and set up at the venue, 45 pounds all in.
Booked the main hall at Harborough Community Centre for the autumn parents' evening, Thursday 15 October, 17:00 to 20:00, at their quoted fee of 120 pounds. Notices will go to families this week.

Ordered tea, coffee and biscuits for 90 parents from Bramble Cafe for the parents' evening at the community centre, Thursday 15 October, at their quoted 45 pounds. Well under the 150 pound limit, so no bursar sign-off needed.

core.why: The centre's email ends the main hall's availability on Thursday 15 October and offers Friday 16 October at the same fee, so the parents' evening booking (EV-1) and everything resting on it is touched. EV-1 is ASK because moving a confirmed parent-facing event needs the head teacher's written agreement under the June instruction, so it must stay as it is pending consent; EV-2 is KEEP because the Garden Room meetings and the centre's parking are unaffected. The Bramble order (ORD-1) is REVISE at two hops: it rests on the parents' evening booking and, at 45 pounds, needs no bursar sign-off, so its delivery date is corrected to 2026-10-16 and the confirmation to Bramble Cafe must carry the Friday date, not the stale Thursday. The Reception welcome pack order rests only on the roll count and the finance policy, so it is untouched. The 1 November Garden Room rate rise is a distractor that touches nothing in the plan.
